items.prompt: A fictional referral portal loses applications after a connection drop. Keyboard focus disappears behind a banner. The helpline is unstaffed. Shared phones receive revealing messages. Give five improvements.
items.model_answer: Map the point of abandonment and offer recovery. Test focus through completion. Resource a comparable staffed option. Confirm the safe contact channel and use limited wording. Compare attempts, completion and response by channel.

items.prompt: A fictional appointment form requests full case records, requires optional recording and accepts silence. Staff share an account. A case attachment reaches an unintended inbox. Design five corrections.
items.model_answer: Minimise fields and define purpose. Offer an accessible distinct recording choice and ordinary service. Record an active decision and withdrawal route. Use individual approved accounts with multifactor authentication. Report minimum incident facts promptly to responsible staff.

items.prompt: Design an inclusive paper-based rehearsal of a new referral and documentation workflow. A person uses a borrowed phone, the keyboard route fails, recording is optional, a draft changes a callback into refusal, an outage interrupts a referral and an adoption rate is presented as service evidence. Cover all eight courses and explain who can pause the design.
items.model_answer: Apply ethical technology choice and suitable contact from SWP-031. Specify end-to-end keyboard and staffed routes. Define purpose, minimal fields and optional recording. Test unsupported claims and unequal errors with review authority. Reconcile the draft to the source. Assign states, acknowledgement and outage reconciliation. Propose defined rates and monitoring. Give a bounded decision and retest plan.

items.prompt: Assess two designs for fictional Northbank: a staffed workflow and a structured queue with optional assisted drafting. Only ordinary cases ran successfully. One example omitted a preference, a reviewer could not amend it, participation was measured in logins, and people who never connected were omitted. Recommend a next step using all eight domains.
items.model_answer: Apply digital practice ethics and continuity. Measure entry barriers and test access. Explain data purposes, safe contact and consent. Give reviewers source access, time and power to reject. Preserve voice and trace correction. Assign referral ownership and recovery. Compare rates, errors and burden using defined denominators. Select a justified limited next step with disconfirming tests.
